memories: The player said: I lost my dog, a little brown terrier named Pip. You answered: I'll keep an eye out for him.
The player said: The Kowalskis' dog bit me on the hand yesterday. You answered: That hound has always been mean.
The player said: My sister Clara is getting married next spring. You answered: Congratulations to her.
The player said: My brother broke his arm falling off the barn roof. You answered: Tell him to rest it.
The player said: I'm looking for work at the docks. You answered: Ask for Henry at the harbor office.
The player said: I got the job at the mill. You answered: The foreman there is fair.
The player said: I think Walter Vance cheated me at cards. You answered: Walter always did play loose with the rules.
The player said: Walter Vance lent me ten dollars. You answered: Pay him back quickly, he keeps count.
The player said: I bought a cat from the Garrity farm. You answered: Their barn cats are good mousers.
The player said: I want to open a bakery someday. You answered: Clyde would hate the competition.
The player said: The mayor's speech was dull. You answered: They always are.
The player said: I saw Gladys Garrity crying behind the church. You answered: Best leave her be.
The player said: I owe the bank fifty dollars. You answered: Radcliffe won't wait long for it.
The player said: My grandmother taught me to fish. You answered: The river's good for trout in June.
The player said: I heard wolves near the Underhill place. You answered: Keep your shutters closed.
The player said: My mother is sick with a fever. You answered: Doctor Singh makes house calls.
The player said: I found an old map in my attic. You answered: Some say the founders buried something.
The player said: I'm learning to play the fiddle. You answered: Fairchild's sells strings.
The player said: My roof leaks every time it rains. You answered: Tar it before winter.
The player said: I don't trust the new sheriff. You answered: Keep your voice down about that.
The player said: I'm saving up to buy a horse. You answered: Look at the Reyes stables.
The player said: My father fought in the war. You answered: Many here did.
The player said: I can't sleep because of the church bells. You answered: You get used to them.
The player said: I planted tomatoes behind my house. You answered: Watch for frost in May.
The player said: I'm thinking of leaving Maple Hollow. You answered: The city isn't kind to newcomers.
The player said: Henry Quill owes my uncle money. You answered: Half the town is owed by Henry.
The player said: I broke my grandmother's teapot. You answered: Mercer's might have one like it.
The player said: The baker gave me free bread. You answered: Clyde has a soft heart under the flour.
The player said: I want to marry Edna someday. You answered: Ask her father first.
The player said: Someone stole my bicycle. You answered: Check behind the tavern.

I paid Walter back what he lent me.

I found a shop I could rent for my bakery.
I paid the bank what I owed.

The wolves came closer last night.

I learned my first song on the fiddle.

Did you see the horses at the Reyes place?

Nice day today, isn't it?
